Name: Midea AC
Author: Jason Zeng
Description: Control and monitor a Midea Duo portable air conditioner. Keys show live room temperature and setpoint.

Actions.Name: AC Power
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle the air conditioner. Shows power state and room temperature.

Actions.Name: Temperature Up
Actions.Tooltip: Raise the setpoint by 1F. Shows the current setpoint.

Actions.Name: Temperature Down
Actions.Tooltip: Lower the setpoint by 1F. Shows the current setpoint.

Actions.Name: AC Status
Actions.Tooltip: Live room temperature, setpoint and mode. Press to refresh.
